name: smwgraphics-wooden-castle
title: Wooden Castle
description:
I worked on my release a bit more. Now it's complete, but with more tiles, such as dark pillars, statues and sideways ladders. Comes with 2 versions. They DO share Map16 for both the BG and FG. Let's see:
-Version 1.5 has 5 ExGFX files. The BG and stars are merged into a layer and the stars are exanimated.
-Version 2.5 has 7 ExGFX files. The last 2 are for layer 3. You know the drill.
Also, every version has its own palette. It's not much really.
Each version has its .mwl file.
Give credit, if used.
Version 1 works with SMW regular status bar.

mod note: as the original status bar will cut fullscreen layer 3 backgrounds off, you may want to use a status bar patch (e.g. Sprite Status Bar)
